LanguageData.VFEC_Beacons.description: Build large wooden pyres, that when lit on fire are guaranteed to summon friendly reinforcements.

VFEC_Beacons.generalRules.rulesStrings.li: subject_story->constructed large wooden pyres, a signal to the skies that calls forth allies to the battlefield
subject_gerund->binding the fates of allies with flames that guide them to the fray

LanguageData.VFEC_Beacons.label: beacons
LanguageData.VFEC_BronzeWorking.description: Mix steel with stone chunks to create slightly weaker metal in large quantities.

VFEC_BronzeWorking.generalRules.rulesStr.li: subject_story->discovered the alchemy of combining steel with stone to produce bronze, marking the dawn of a new era in metallurgy
subject_gerund->ushering in an age where metal becomes the backbone of progress and power

LanguageData.VFEC_BronzeWorking.label: bronze working
LanguageData.VFEC_CementMaking.description: Construct a cement press, which allows you to create extremely durable stone material out of stone chunks.

VFEC_CementMaking.generalRules.rulesStri.li: subject_story->innovated the creation of cement, turning stone into the durable foundation upon which empires are built
subject_gerund->laying the groundwork for enduring structures and monuments with the strength of cement

LanguageData.VFEC_CementMaking.label: cement making
LanguageData.VFEC_CenturionArmor.description: Smith suits of centurion armor, excellent for leading men into heroic battles.

VFEC_CenturionArmor.generalRules.rulesSt.li: subject_story->smithed suits of centurion armor, imbuing leaders with both protection and a distinguished presence
subject_gerund->clothing the ranks of leadership in armor befitting their valor and virtue

LanguageData.VFEC_CenturionArmor.label: centurion armor
LanguageData.VFEC_CraftingBench.description: Build a workbench for crafting simple things like clubs or bows.

VFEC_CraftingBench.generalRules.rulesStr.li: subject_story->established crafting benches as the heart of production, where raw materials are transformed into tools and treasures
subject_gerund->carving the future with every crafted item, from the simplest club to the most precise bow

LanguageData.VFEC_CraftingBench.label: crafting bench
LanguageData.VFEC_DramaAndComedy.description: Perform various plays on the theatre stage as a recreational activity.

VFEC_DramaAndComedy.generalRules.rulesSt.li: subject_story->revived the timeless arts of drama and comedy, enriching the soul of the republic through performance and play
subject_gerund->mirroring the human condition, from tragedy to farce, on the communal stage

LanguageData.VFEC_DramaAndComedy.label: drama and comedy
LanguageData.VFEC_HeavyShieldMaking.description: Create heavy scuta shields typically associated with legionnaires.

VFEC_HeavyShieldMaking.generalRules.rule.li: subject_story->reinvigorated the tradition of heavy shield crafting, providing unmatched protection to those who hold the line
subject_gerund->forging the scuta shields, the steadfast guardians of the legionnaires

LanguageData.VFEC_HeavyShieldMaking.label: heavy shield making
LanguageData.VFEC_LegionaryArmaments.description: Craft tents, javelins, spathas and daggers, constituting towards the legionary armory.

VFEC_LegionaryArmaments.generalRules.rul.li: subject_story->mastered the fabrication of javelins, spathas, and daggers, ensuring the legion's versatility and readiness in battle
subject_gerund->equipping the legions with a diverse armory for conquest and defense

LanguageData.VFEC_LegionaryArmaments.label: legionary armaments
LanguageData.VFEC_LegionnaireArmor.description: Create heavy armor of legionaries, capable of withstanding a high degree of sharp damage.

VFEC_LegionnaireArmor.generalRules.rules.li: subject_story->crafted heavy armor that turns warriors into indomitable forces on the battlefield, capable of withstanding the fiercest strikes
subject_gerund->donning the legionnaires in armor that weaves invincibility with the threads of war

LanguageData.VFEC_LegionnaireArmor.label: legionary armor
LanguageData.VFEC_MeatDrying.description: Construct meat drying racks, allowing you to preserve meat and create a roman delicacy.

VFEC_MeatDrying.generalRules.rulesString.li: subject_story->revived the ancient art of meat drying, securing sustenance and delighting palates with flavors honed by time
subject_gerund->extending the bounty of the hunt through the wisdom of the ancients

LanguageData.VFEC_MeatDrying.label: meat drying
LanguageData.VFEC_Mosaics.description: Build excellent stone mosaics, utilising different colours and shapes to express beauty. Slow to construct.

VFEC_Mosaics.generalRules.rulesStrings.li: subject_story->crafted stone mosaics that capture the essence of beauty and narrative through color and form
subject_gerund->embedding the story of a people in the very stones that pave their path

LanguageData.VFEC_Mosaics.label: mosaics
LanguageData.VFEC_RoadBuilding.description: Construct paths, dirt roads and stone roads directly on the world map, allowing for faster caravan travel.

VFEC_RoadBuilding.generalRules.rulesStri.li: subject_story->paved the way for civilization's expansion with the construction of roads, connecting communities and fostering trade
subject_gerund->tracing the arteries of trade and communication with each road built, propelling the civilization forward

LanguageData.VFEC_RoadBuilding.label: road building
LanguageData.VFEC_Scorpion.description: Construct scorpions, a portable field artillery piece which doubles as a semi-automatic heavy crossbow.

VFEC_Scorpion.generalRules.rulesStrings.li: subject_story->engineered scorpions, merging the precision of a crossbow with the destructive force of field artillery
subject_gerund->unleashing the lethal precision of ancient war machines upon the modern battlefield

LanguageData.VFEC_Scorpion.label: scorpion
LanguageData.VFEC_TemperatureControl.description: Make large passive coolers, a way to cool indoor spaces below freezing point without needing electricity, or hot stones, a primitive heater.

VFEC_TemperatureControl.generalRules.rul.li: subject_story->harnessed natural methods to defy the whims of weather, creating spaces of comfort through passive coolers and hot stones
subject_gerund->cultivating havens of warmth and coolness, in defiance of the external world

LanguageData.VFEC_TemperatureControl.label: temperature control
LanguageData.VFEC_Thermaebath.description: Construct large thermaebath that uses steam geysers to warm up the water, allowing up to 8 people to bathe together with an occasional chance of group lovin’.

VFEC_Thermaebath.generalRules.rulesStrin.li: subject_story->constructed thermaebaths, communal havens of relaxation and warmth powered by the earth's breath
subject_gerund->fostering communal well-being and intimacy in the embrace of nature's warmth

LanguageData.VFEC_Thermaebath.label: thermaebath
LanguageData.VFEC_Togas.description: Craft togas, everyday wear of the citizens of the republic.

VFEC_Togas.generalRules.rulesStrings.li: subject_story->reclaimed the elegance and simplicity of the toga, the symbol of citizenship and refined taste
subject_gerund->draping the republic in the dignity and grace of its ancestors

LanguageData.VFEC_Togas.label: togas
LanguageData.VFEC_TyrianProduction.description: Create a tyrian farm - a river-bank structure that dyes cloth, which can then be extracted in the form of extremely valuable royal fabric.

VFEC_TyrianProduction.generalRules.rules.li: subject_story->cultivated tyrian farms along the riverbanks, mastering the art of dyeing cloth into royal fabric, a symbol of wealth and status
subject_gerund->weaving the fabric of society with colors that command respect and admiration

LanguageData.VFEC_TyrianProduction.label: tyrian production
LanguageData.VFEC_WoodfiredCrematorium.description: Build a huge, wood-fired stone crematorium which vaporizes corpses with high temperatures.

VFEC_WoodfiredCrematorium.generalRules.r.li: subject_story->conceived the wood-fired crematorium, a testament to dealing with the departed in a manner that respects both cultural customs and sanitation needs
subject_gerund->embracing the cycle of life and death through the elemental purity of fire

LanguageData.VFEC_WoodfiredCrematorium.label: wood-fired crematorium
